meta.title: Bohdan Moroz — Software Engineer · Applied AI
meta.description: Bohdan Moroz — software engineer working in applied AI. Four years building production web and mobile apps for US logistics, HR, and fintech teams. Open to freelance work.

schema.occupationSkills: TypeScript, React, Next.js, NestJS, React Native, Expo, applied AI, agentic LLM workflows, self-hosted inference (Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM), Docker, CI/CD
schema.seeksDescription: Open to freelance full-stack TypeScript engagements with US SMBs in logistics, HR, and fintech. Remote, or in person in Sofia.

hero.tagline: Four years shipping production web & mobile systems for US logistics, HR & fintech operators.

protocol.title: Operating Protocol
protocol.subtitle: << WHAT WORKING WITH ME LOOKS LIKE >>

items.name: Ownership
items.rest: Comfortable taking a feature from a half-formed Figma or a paragraph of requirements all the way through frontend, backend, infrastructure and deploy — no handoffs.

items.name: Stack
items.rest: React / Next.js on web, React Native (Expo) on mobile, NestJS / Fastify / Express on the server. CI/CD, testing, Docker by default; self-host when it makes sense, AWS / Vercel / Hetzner when it doesn't.

items.name: Throughput
items.lead: Agentic AI is core to how I work.
items.rest: I've built my own tooling around it, so agents handle the typing while I drive architecture, review and integration. I can also set up and run the infrastructure itself — self-hosted inference, gateways, routing — which I do day-to-day on corporate stacks.

items.name: Comms
items.rest: Used to working with US clients from Sofia, Bulgaria (UTC+2). Operates in English, Ukrainian and Russian.
